I am now genuinely shocked by how Pacific Cross handles claims. My recent experience has gone from frustrating to outright unbelievable.

After submitting a completely standard claim for sudden abdominal and pelvic pain, Pacific Cross has now begun claiming that my symptoms were “caused by IUD insertion.” This would be hilarious if it weren’t so concerning — my IUD was inserted four years ago in London, not by any clinic in Thailand, and the hospital’s medical report clearly stated abdominal/pelvic pain with no IUD complication whatsoever.

Despite this, Pacific Cross is attempting to rewrite the medical facts to fit an exclusion clause. This behaviour raises serious questions about the company’s integrity and claims-processing practices.

I have now opened a formal complaint and am documenting the matter for a potential investigation with the Office of Insurance Commission (OIC), as the insurer’s conduct appears inconsistent with fair claims handling and may constitute a breach of regulatory standards, including:
•	Misrepresentation of medical facts
•	Improper application of exclusion clauses
•	Failure to act with due care and transparency
•	Unreasonable delay in claims assessment

The pattern is very clear: Pacific Cross will look for any excuse not to pay, even if that means inventing one. I strongly advise anyone considering this company to stay well clear. The service is unprofessional, inconsistent, and deeply disappointing.

I'd like to share my review of Pacific Cross insurance; maybe it will help someone avoid making the same mistake I did. They market themselves as a company where you can just show up at the hospital and get treatment cashless. In other words, they'll pay for everything upfront (the hospital staff will send you the documents, etc.), like with Tinkoff Insurance, for example. But in reality, they simply won't respond until late in the evening, after you've already paid for everything. Coincidentally, I was waiting for the ultrasound department to open, so I had no choice but to sit and wait. After five hours at the hospital, I still hadn't received a response. It wasn't until 5 PM that evening that I received a reply. The text message informing me that the documents had been received and they were reviewing my case arrived at 10:23 AM. I find this type of scam unacceptable.

If you're looking for health insurance that's easy to claim and doesn't require upfront payment, I recommend Pacific Cross Health Insurance. You can call their Pattaya branch for inquiries. Their staff are friendly and provide excellent advice.

I called to inquire about health insurance, and the staff at the branch provided very clear information and explanations. The branch is also conveniently located on Sukhumvit Road just before North Pattaya, and easily visible.
All the staff are lovely and provide excellent service.
Very attentive and helpful staff/advisors in the Pattaya office
